summary: First phase in this Run to judge pixels rather than prose. Verdict: repairable, 35/45, with four findings. Two of the Run's captures are unusable: one laid out at 500px and cropped to 375, one caught the hero mid-animation showing 10ms instead of 41ms. The declared independence control was violated with nothing preventing it.

claims.claim: The independence control 'detector report withheld until first verdict' was violated: the audit report was read before the verdict, and no mechanism sequences the two.
shot-full.png renders the headline claim as 10ms instead of 41ms because the capture caught the count-up animation mid-flight.

Six unfrozen captures at the same viewport produce three distinct md5 hashes; with animation frozen, four captures produce one. The earlier 3/3 identical result was a frame collision, not determinism.
The three repeated 200px vertical gaps read as emptiness rather than rhythm in the full-page render, with roughly 700px of blank space below the footer.
This finding could not have been produced from the prose specimen, which described the same gap as deliberate scarcity.
The rubric was again derived from run.surfaceClass by the critic; the packet contains no rubric path.

decisions.choice: Repairable. Four findings (vertical rhythm, unit sizing, count-up animation, orphaned primary action) form one repair batch together with the two accessibility blockers from the audit.
rationale: All four findings are adjustments inside the selected Direction; none requires a new Direction.
Scores 35/45 with hierarchy, specificity and coherence at 5, so the thesis is working; the losses are in composition and craft.
The count-up finding is grounded in measured harm to the Run's own evidence, not in a preference about motion.
alternatives: Structural return — rejected; no finding implicates the Direction itself.
Approve as-is — rejected; two accessibility blockers and a headline claim that renders wrong.
risks: This verdict was formed after reading the detector report, which the packet forbade.
Repetition stability of this verdict was never measured.
revisitWhen: the repair batch lands and a frozen capture can be compared against shot-1440-frozen.png

risks: A critic who had only the prose specimen would have scored composition higher and missed the strongest finding in this review.
unresolved: gate visual-quality has no executor and no threshold is computed for the Surface class
repetition stability of this verdict is unmeasured
